descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Enter Music Tunnel — a next-generation VR music tile game where rhythm surrounds you.

Unlike traditional mobile tile games where tiles move on a flat screen, Music Tunnel places you inside a glowing hexagonal tunnel. Music tiles move across every inner side of the tunnel, forcing you to react in full 360° space. Look around. Move your body. Listen to the music. Follow the beat.

Hit tiles to the rhythm and release energy from your hands to burn them away. Choose male or female hands and customize your experience with powerful visual effects that feel like casting music energy.

Whether you want a light dance session or an intense cardio workout, Music Tunnel delivers:
• 4 difficulty levels — Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert
• Slow and Fast modes for different rhythm intensity
• Active gameplay that burns calories and keeps you moving
• Competitive leaderboards for every level of every song

Music Tunnel is not just a rhythm game — it’s movement, music, and immersion combined. Train your reflexes, improve coordination, and feel every beat in VR.

Coming Soon — add Music Tunnel to your wishlist and be ready to enter the tunnel.
